obligations.subject: e46
obligations.response: it can reasonably be estimated where on a vehicle a child or adult pedestrian's head may impact
obligations.ears: By use of the WAD, it can reasonably be estimated where on a vehicle a child or adult pedestrian's head may impact.

obligations.subject: e25
obligations.response: the maximum calculated head injury criterion (HIC) shall not exceed 1,000
obligations.ears: For any two points in time, t1 and t2, during the event which are separated by not more than a 15 millisecond time interval and where t1 is less than t2, the maximum calculated head injury criterion (HIC) shall not exceed 1,000, determined using the resultant head acceleration at the centre of gravity of the headform.

obligations.subject: e25
obligations.response: HIC must not exceed 1,000 over one half of the child headform test area and must not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined child and adult headform test areas
obligations.ears: The HIC shall not exceed 1,000 over one half of the child headform test area and shall not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined child and adult headform test areas.

derived.text: The HIC must not exceed 1,000 over one half of the child headform test area.
The HIC must not exceed 1,000 over two thirds of the combined child and adult headform test areas.

obligations.subject: e25
obligations.response: must not exceed 1,700 for both headforms
obligations.ears: The HIC for the remaining areas shall not exceed 1,700 for both headforms.

obligations.response: A longer duration for the time interval could result in distortions in the data recorded by the headform
obligations.ears: A longer duration for the time interval could result in distortions in the data recorded by the headform, which may lead to inaccurate HIC values.

obligations.subject: e12
obligations.response: the relaxation zone for the child headform test area may be greater than one third of the zone
obligations.ears: The relaxation zone for the child headform test area may be greater than one third of the zone.

obligations.subject: e8
obligations.response: Upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out
obligations.ears: If the lower bumper height is more than 500 mm, upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out.
